scores.tell: Water caustics are a little busy and the frame fills edge to edge. Otherwise it is the same smooth scene style as the real window and map cards.
Too many props crowd the scene (fruit, drinks, bottles, umbrella, lounger), but the painterly shading matches the real swing card.
The orb has a hard white crescent highlight, a glowing rim and an airbrushed swirl inside, so it looks glassier and glowier than the real cards.
The orange background is slightly loud and the buttons are candy-coloured. Form and finish are close to the real cards.
The cactus is an inflated, glossy, balloon-like tube with sausage arms and no thin or flat parts. It is too round and toy-like.
The rocket body has chrome-like gradients and sharp hot spots, a touch too glossy, though the staging matches the whistle card.
It reads as a wide scene: the horizon splits the card and the life ring competes with the pier. Finish is close to the real cards.
The box is puffy, with soft rounded corners and a uniform clay-like matte surface. The dark tiled floor is heavier than on the real cards.
The rover is a chunky toy blob with oversized fat wheels and glossy plastic everywhere. The neon green rays are too hot.
The corals look like plasticine sausages with stippled dots, and the lighting is flat. Four loud hues compete with nothing neutral to rest the eye.
